tools.name: cirqll_get_me
tools.description: Return the Cirqll user the access token belongs to, with roles and permissions. Use it to confirm the account. Cirqll API: GET /auth/me.

tools.name: cirqll_list_customers
tools.description: List customers in the CRM, with paging, filter and sort. Use it for customer overviews and search. Cirqll API: GET /customer.

tools.name: cirqll_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id, with its custom field values and any related data you ask for in with. Cirqll API: GET /customer/{id}.

tools.name: cirqll_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (people at customers). Filter by customer with filter="customer_id:eq:<id>". Cirqll API: GET /contact.

tools.name: cirqll_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks, optionally filtered by date, assignee or customer. Cirqll API: GET /task.

tools.name: cirqll_list_appointments
tools.description: List appointments for calendar and overview use, filter by date range, user or customer. Cirqll API: GET /appointment.

tools.name: cirqll_list_chances
tools.description: List sales opportunities (chances) in the pipeline, filter by stage, value or customer. Cirqll API: GET /chance.

tools.name: cirqll_list_notes
tools.description: List notes attached to customers. Filter by customer with filter="customer_id:eq:<id>". Cirqll API: GET /note.

tools.name: cirqll_create_customer
tools.description: Create a new customer record in the CRM. Only the fields you pass are set. Cirqll API: POST /customer.

tools.name: cirqll_create_task
tools.description: Create a task linked to a customer, with a due date. Cirqll API: POST /task.

tools.name: cirqll_create_note
tools.description: Attach a note to a customer, with a date. Cirqll API: POST /note.
